title: NEW Just Flight Fokker 70 & 100 Arrive in MSFS! (+ A-29 Super Tucano)
description:
Are you looking to expand your virtual hangar in Microsoft Flight Simulator this week, or are you trying to avoid impulse buys on the storefront? Today, we break down the latest marketplace drop featuring three distinct airframes serving up a stark divide in flight styles—ranging from deep study-level regional twin-jets to modern tactical turboprop attack operations.

To help you decide what fits your flight routine and budget, we inspect each arrival in detail:

• Just Flight Fokker 70 & Fokker 100 Professional: Highly anticipated, study-level regional airliners built using real-world pilot and engineer documentation. Featuring comprehensively customized electrical, hydraulic, fuel, and pressurization systems, custom AFCS/ATS/FMS avionics, crisp PBR texturing with cockpit wear-and-tear, functional cabin and exterior details, and a fully featured EFB with SimBrief/Navigraph integration and performance calculators. Available individually or in a heavily discounted fleet bundle.
• RPSimulations EMB-314 / A-29 Super Tucano: A tactical tandem-seat turboprop developed for advanced military flight training, light attack, and reconnaissance. Powered by a 1,600 SHP Pratt & Whitney Canada PT6A-68C engine, this package includes custom cockpit glass displays (HUD, UFCP, MFDs), animated surfaces and speed brakes, store management system (SMS) functions, demonstration smoke, and authentic military liveries.

Whether you're after complex IFR regional hops in classic European twin-jets or high-adrenaline tactical turboprop sorties, we evaluate each package to help you decide what truly deserves a spot in your virtual hangar.

If you enjoy honest, clear, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below! Which of these aircraft are you adding to your hangar?
